proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4424 ghana explicitly gives Sindhi ghaṇo much/many, western ghaṇā and Old Gujarati ghaṇauṁ much. Bhili/Bhilali ghanu/gheṇā many fit that western family, retaining regional vowel variation and aspiration. No unsupported extra suffix is absorbed and the local transmission route remains unresolved. Exact response: ghanu.
